title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Program Standards for Refinance Seasoning, Occupancy and Closing Charges
content:
The VA Home Loan Guaranty applies the following standards when a loan is guaranteed.

**Program limits.** Each program sets its own maximum loan-to-value and maximum term and, for the Native American Direct Loan, a VA interest rate and a trust-land requirement.

**Refinance seasoning.** A refinance, whether a rate reduction refinance or a cash-out refinance, closes only after the program's seasoning period of days has passed from the first payment due date of the loan being refinanced, and after the program's minimum number of monthly payments on that loan.

**Rate reduction refinance.** A rate reduction refinance must lower a fixed rate by at least the program's minimum rate reduction in points, recoup its costs within the program's recoupment period of months, and extend the term by no more than the program's maximum term extension in years.

**Occupancy.** The veteran must occupy the home within the program's occupancy period of days after closing, or up to the program's longest delay in months with a documented reason. A rate reduction refinance needs only prior occupancy.

**Lender and seller charges.** Lenders may charge an origination fee of no more than the program's maximum origination percentage; seller concessions are limited to the program's maximum seller concession percentage.

**Improvements and appraisal.** Energy efficient improvements up to the program's maximum may be added, and an appraisal is valid for the program's appraisal validity period of days.

## Checks combined for a refinance (hypothetical)

| Hypothetical refinance | Days since the first payment due date of the loan refinanced | Monthly payments made on it | Seasoning met |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | More than the seasoning period | At least the minimum | Yes |
| B | More than the seasoning period | Fewer than the minimum | No |
| C | Fewer than the seasoning period | At least the minimum | No |

## Occupancy by loan type

| Loan | Occupancy standard |
|---|---|
| Purchase or cash-out refinance | Occupy within the occupancy period, or within the longest delay with a documented reason |
| Rate reduction refinance | Prior occupancy only |
